info.name: GeoNames API (gazetteer for genealogy)
info.description:
GeoNames web services: more than 12M place names with alternate and historic spellings, administrative hierarchy, coordinates, reverse geocoding, postal codes and Wikipedia.

**Setup:** create a free account at https://www.geonames.org/login, then on https://www.geonames.org/manageaccount click **"Click here to enable"** free web services. Put your username in the collection variable `geonames_username`. Free limits: 10,000 credits a day and 1,000 an hour.

Docs: https://www.geonames.org/export/ws-overview.html

exec: if(!pm.collectionVariables.get('geonames_username')){console.warn('Set the collection variable geonames_username (free account at geonames.org with web services enabled).');}

request.description: Searches place names (including alternate and historic names), countries and admin codes. Sets {{geonameId}} from the first result.
